caption: The drawing depicts two representations of the same pitcher. The main object, centered and taking up most of the image, is a glass pitcher colored in shades of red and pink, with detailed highlights and shadows indicating transparency and refraction typical of glass. The pitcher has a bulbous lower body and a cylindrical neck, with a wide, clear glass handle attached to the upper part. Decorative floral engravings, including leaves and flowers, are visible etched into the surface of the pinkish glass body. In the upper left corner, there is a simple line drawing of the same pitcher with identical proportions and decorations, but with no coloring; this version focuses solely on the shape and placement of the floral engravings. The background is a plain, light beige color, with no other objects or details present.
title: Ruby Pitcher
